{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.14

|arg= local
|gr1= Remote Control

|descr= Returns [[true]] if the given player is remote-controlling a unit.
{{Feature|important|See also [[Remote Control Tutorial]].}}

|s1= [[isRemoteControlling]] person

|p1= person: [[Object]] - a player 

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if the given player is remote controlling a unit

|x1= <sqf>
if (isRemoteControlling player) then
{
	hint format ["You are controlling %1", remoteControlled player];
}
else
{
	hint "Why not remote-control something?";
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[remoteControl]] [[remoteControlled]]
}}
